size.description: Growth-only policy. Absolute repository size is not gated; only the delta between --base and HEAD git trees is gated. Never treat a prior absolute byte count as an accepted baseline.

compile.description: Exact-path allowlist for tracked .cs files that are intentionally uncompiled or intentionally compiled only by the test project. Any tracked .cs not matched by MSBuild compile-item evaluation of the production/test projects, a discovered standalone tool project, or this allowlist is a NEW unclassified violation and fails the gate.
